test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following question is based on the given words.

PLAN FORE RAMP RANG SAND

If in each word, the fourth letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order, how many letter clusters thus formed will have two vowels?
solution:
Given:

PLAN FORE RAMP RANG SAND

The fourth letter is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order:

PLAN → “N” is replaced with the next alphabet “O” → PL***__AO__*** - 2 vowels A, O

FORE → “M” is replaced with the next alphabet “N” → F***__O__***RF

RAMP → “P” is replaced with the next alphabet “Q” → R***__A__***MQ

RANG → “G” is replaced with the next alphabet “H” → R***__A__***NH

SAND → “D” is replaced with the next alphabet “E” → S***__A__***N***__E__*** - 2 vowels A, E

Hence, **“Two”** letter clusters thus formed will have two vowels
